agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/filters/reindent.py ReindentFilter._next_token: an inverted condition (`if not (token and token.normalized == 'BETWEEN'):`) caused unconditional recursion for every split keyword, eventually calling token_next_by with idx=None, raising TypeError on += for NoneType. Corrected the condition to `if token and token.normalized == 'BETWEEN':` so recursion only happens for the BETWEEN...AND special case, restoring correct reindent behavior. Verified sqlparse.format(..., reindent=True) works again for plain queries and BETWEEN/AND/GROUP BY/ORDER BY cases, and existing working paths (reindent_aligned, CLI) remain unaffected.
